_about: G3 real recordings (WP7). Written BEFORE running the pipeline on them: what is known about each file (from its SigMF description, annotations and the public standard), and the sanity check it must pass. Files are the public IQEngine GNU Radio SigMF repo (iqengine.org/api/datasources/local/local/<name>); large files were truncated to their first 16,000,000 bytes (stored under artifacts/readiness/real/, not in git). Frequencies in the checks are baseband offsets from the capture centre.
common_checks: every published label is in allowed_labels
every published rate for an allowed label is within 5% of expected_rate_hz
